description:
Make a separate tracking link (and promo code) for every channel where an ad is placed in MAX, so you can
    see which placement brought users and sales. Bot links use ?start=<id>: the id arrives in bot_started.payload,
    which works even for clicks that never leave the messenger. Returns a media plan as CSV.
    Then feed the counts to max_ad_report.

bot_name.description: Your bot's public name: each placement gets max.ru/<bot>?start=<id>
bot_name.title: Bot Name

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

mini_app_bot.description: Bot with your mini-app: each placement gets ?startapp=<id>
mini_app_bot.title: Mini App Bot

placements.description: Channels where the ad goes: [{name, cost?, erid?}]. name may be a title or max.ru link
placements.title: Placements

promo_codes.description: Also make one promo code per placement
promo_codes.title: Promo Codes

site_url.description: Landing page: each placement gets UTM tags and its erid
site_url.title: Site Url

name: max_tracking_links
